query:
SELECT 
  fr.id,
  fr.client_name,
  fr.recorded_by,
  fr.asaas_charge_id,
  fr.sync_status,
  fr.sync_error,
  fr.recorded_at,
  u.role as creator_role
FROM fuel_records fr
LEFT JOIN users u ON fr.recorded_by = u.name
ORDER BY fr.recorded_at DESC 
LIMIT 10;
